ruleCategories.name: Warbands
ruleCategories.description: Rules concerning the creation and management of a warband.

ruleCategories.name: Heroes
ruleCategories.description: Rules concerning Heroes, experience and advances.

ruleCategories.name: Henchmen
ruleCategories.description: Rules concerning Henchmen and Henchmen groups.

ruleCategories.name: Equipment
ruleCategories.description: Rules concerning weapons, armour and other equipment.

ruleCategories.name: Injuries
ruleCategories.description: Rules concerning injuries suffered during games.

ruleCategories.name: Post-game
ruleCategories.description: Rules concerning the sequence following a battle.

rules.name: Starting a Warband
rules.summary: A warband is assembled using its starting treasury and the restrictions defined by its warband list.

rules.name: Heroes
rules.summary: Heroes form the leaders and experienced fighters of a warband and can gain experience and advances.

rules.name: Henchmen
rules.summary: Henchmen are recruited according to the restrictions of the warband and may be organised into Henchmen groups.

rules.name: Experience
rules.summary: Fighters can gain experience through battles and use experience to receive advances.

rules.name: Warband Rating
rules.summary: A warband's rating represents the overall experience and strength of the warband.
